        Perfect Parry
        Timing battle
        Perfect Parry
        • Monsters attack in combos. Watch each one closely: it pulls back, flashes a ✦ glint, then swings. Tap PARRY right as the hit lands.
        • Parry every hit in a combo to counterattack!
        • Red attacks can’t be parried. DODGE those instead.
        • Sneaky attacks don’t flash a glint, so you’ll have to read the monster’s moves. Turn the sound on: every glint goes “shing!”
        • Each parry gives you ⚡ energy for a Special attack or a Heal.
        • Keyboard: Space = parry, Shift or K = dodge, 1–3 = actions.
        You

        Confuse the AI
        Brain-melting challenge
        Confuse the AI

        These robots brag that nothing can confuse them. Prove them wrong! Send paradoxes, impossible questions, and weird tricks to fill the confusion meter to 100% before your 10 messages run out.

        • Each kind of trick only works well once. The robots learn!
        • Fit two different tricks in one message for a combo.
        • The 💡 idea buttons work great on BYTE-9000, but smarter robots have heard them all. Type tricks in your own words!
        • Stuck? Ask the robot for a hint. Your first 3 hints are free.

        These robots are pretend. Their brains live inside this app, so nothing you type gets sent anywhere.

        Overclock
        How to play
        • 💵 Your computer does jobs for customers and earns money every second.
        • 🚀 Crank up the CPU clock to earn more money, but it gets hotter.
        • 🌀 Fans and better coolers keep it cool. 🧹 Dust and dried-out thermal paste make cooling worse.
        • ⚡ Don’t use more power than your power supply can handle.
        • 🔥 Over 100°C things start smoking, and they can catch fire. If that happens, tap 🧯 SPRAY fast!

        Real life: real computers have safety limits, so they almost never catch fire. If one ever smells like smoke, tell an adult right away.

            Foul Play
            How to play
            • 🏀 Drag on the court to move your player: the 😈 with the ⭐.
            • 🤫 Get close to someone on the red team, then tap a foul button. Riskier fouls are worth more points.
            • 🐢 When you get close to someone, time goes into slow-mo for everyone but you: the players, the ref and even the clock. Perfect for sneaky fouls!
            • 👀 The yellow cone is where the ref is looking. If he sees a foul, it’s a strike on you. 3 strikes and you foul out!
            • ❗ Watch for the ❗ over the ref: he’s about to look somewhere else, maybe right at you.
            • 😠 Don’t foul the same player too much. When they get a ❗, one more foul and they’ll tell the ref.
            • 🏀 Foul the player with the ball for double points. Make them drop it and your team scores!
            • 💸 Spend your sneak points to bribe the ref, distract him with a hot dog, or buy sneaky stuff between quarters.

            It’s a silly cartoon game. In real basketball, play fair! 🙂
